correctness.rationale: Reflection splits the odd chorded cycle Laplacian; cosine even modes are nowhere zero on integer vertices, strict Jacobi rank-one interlacing separates even/odd eigenvalues, and a Chebyshev-root/cyclotomic divisibility contradiction proves no odd Jacobi eigenvector has a zero coordinate. PBH gives all n>=5 odd and all vertices. Replayed self-contained exact modular Krylov verifier passed all 320 positions n=5,7,...35; finite checks corroborate, not replace proof.
